def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frame = 5
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if frame in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == frame for r in range(h))]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    marks = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (0, frame)]
    # The two markers label the two alternating pairs of quadrants.
    a, b = marks[0][2], marks[1][2]
    # The outside markers color the adjacent pair of interior quadrants.
    if marks[0][0] > r1:
        a, b = b, a
    midr, midc = (r0 + r1) / 2, (c0 + c1) / 2
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            top = r < midr
            left = c < midc
            out[r][c] = a if top == left else b
    return out
